entries.df733a23f2ae2696: Since its founding in 1938, it has cultivated sewing technology centered on industrial sewing machines. Its Otawara Plant is its main plant, and it has a global production and sales structure consisting of overseas production bases in China and Vietnam and sales subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, Asia, China and India. Its strengths are the technological foundations of its two businesses, sewing and industrial machinery: its solution proposal capability through the integration of IoT into industrial sewing machines, and the implementation technology of its Industrial Equipment Business.

entries.efb84a2ea30e9003: The company is promoting its five-year medium-term management plan, “Building Sustainable JUKI,” covering 2025 to 2029. Its basic policies are three: growth centered on its two businesses, strengthening cost competitiveness and financial base, and practicing ESG management. In the Sewing Business, it will accelerate locking in high-end customers through solution proposals that integrate IoT, and it will also expand household sewing machines. In the Industrial Machinery Business, the Industrial Equipment Business is shifting to a global niche strategy focused on priority areas and regions, and in the Contract Business it is strengthening the search for a third pillar by leveraging its technological capabilities. The medium-term management plan is to be reviewed every year.
